rubric.description: (a) Isolates each character correctly (`charAt` or `substring(i, i + 1)`)
(a) Tests for a vowel in either case
(a) Builds the result with only the non-vowels, in order, and returns it
(b) Finds an occurrence with `indexOf` and loops until none is found (`-1`)
(b) Searches again from an index that allows overlapping matches (`pos + 1`, not `pos + sub.length()`)
(b) Counts each match and returns the count
(a) Compares the areas by calling `area()` on both rectangles
(a) Returns the correct rectangle reference, `a` when the areas are equal
(b) Creates and returns a new `Rectangle` with the `Rectangle` constructor
(b) Uses the greater width (`Math.max` or equivalent) and the sum of the heights
(c) Computes the scale factor as the square root of `targetArea / r.area()`
(c) Returns a new scaled rectangle (using `scaled` or the constructor) without modifying `r`
